parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The reason why the vulnerability can be automatically fixed.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the vulnerability. Valid values: -**cve**: Linux software vulnerability -**sys**: Windows system vulnerability

parameters.name: VulAutoRepairConfigList
parameters.description: The vulnerabilities that can be automatically fixed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-vul-auto-repair-config --type cve --vul-auto-repair-config-list AliasName=CVE-2018-25032:zlib_1.2.11_memory_corruption Name=anolisos:8.4:ANSA-2022:0001 --reason TestAutoRepair --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas CreateVulAutoRepairConfig --region cn-hangzhou --VulAutoRepairConfigList.1.Name 'anolisos:8.4:ANSA-2022:0001' --Type cve --VulAutoRepairConfigList.1.AliasName 'CVE-2018-25032:zlib_1.2.11_memory_corruption' --Reason TestAutoRepair
